extDescription.message: Bridges your logged-in Dynatrace Managed browser session to a local MCP server so AI assistants can query services, traces, metrics and problems. Read-only.

wsHint.message: Your AI client starts it automatically while it's open. Not set up yet? Run this once:

wsHintLink.message: Using Cursor, Codex or another client? See setup

environmentsNone.message: None yet. Open a Dynatrace environment and add it here.

openInNewTabTitle.message: Open Dynatrace in a new tab

tabClosed.message: No tab open; one is opened in front when the AI needs it, so you can log in if asked

noSiteAccess.message: Site access was revoked. Remove this environment and add it again.

renameEnvTitle.message: Click to rename. The AI selects the environment by this name.

addEnvironmentHint.message: Chrome will ask for access to this site. If the popup closes, the environment is still added, so reopen to check.

allowSiteAccess.message: Allow site access in the Chrome prompt…

notDynatracePage.message: The active tab is not a Dynatrace environment page. Open Dynatrace (a URL containing /e/<environment id>/) and reopen this popup to add it.

notLoggedIn.message: This looks like a Dynatrace environment, but you are not logged in. Log in to Dynatrace in this tab, then reopen this popup.

pageNotReadable.message: This tab could not be read. Reload the page and reopen this popup.

errInvalidName.message: Use letters, digits, spaces, dots, dashes and underscores only, starting with a letter or digit (at most 64 characters)

errInvalidPort.message: The port must be between 1 and 65535

badgeNoServerTitle.message: Dynatrace Bridge: waiting for your AI client. The MCP server starts automatically while Claude Code, Cursor or another MCP client that uses it is open.

badgeConnectedTitle.message: Dynatrace Bridge: the AI can query "$1" through this tab (read-only).

updateExtensionText.message: The MCP server is v$1 and this extension is v$2. Run this command:

updateExtensionReload.message: Then click reload on this extension in your browser's extensions page (chrome://extensions).

updateRestartText.message: This extension is v$2 but the running MCP server is v$1. Restart your AI client so that it starts the current server.

updateServerText.message: dynatrace-bridge-mcp v$1 has been released and the running server is v$2. Restart your AI client to start the new version, then update this extension when it asks.

badgeExtensionOutdatedTitle.message: Dynatrace Bridge: the MCP server is v$1 and this extension is v$2. Run npx -y dynatrace-bridge-mcp@latest install-extension, then click reload on the extensions page. The extension popup has the command.

badgeServerRestartTitle.message: Dynatrace Bridge: this extension is v$2 but the running MCP server is v$1. Restart your AI client so that it starts the current server.

badgeServerUpdateTitle.message: Dynatrace Bridge: dynatrace-bridge-mcp v$1 has been released and the running server is v$2. Restart your AI client to start the new version.
